epic.title: This run's review: decisions, undecided items, the map
epic.description:
Phil's look back at the unattended run of 2026-11-28: one checklist of every decision the run made for him (keep or undo), one checklist of every item from the old chats that nobody has asked him about (keep, drop or later, about 47 rows), and the live roadmap page in Mycelium that the Final five asked for as a ticket. The one-off map in Docs (review.04) was made by the run and is listed in the index, not ticketed.

## Order
review.01 and review.02 in any order, in 15-minute sittings. review.03 is a build and waits for nothing in this epic.

## Done means
Every decision is kept or undone; every H10 item is kept (and ticketed), dropped or marked later; the roadmap page shows the next unblocked ticket.

## Flags
- H10: nothing in the undecided list has been put to Phil as a question; review.02 is that question, one row each.

## Dossier
The dossier is attached in Docs: (link filled by the integrator).

tickets.title: Review: decisions made for me on 2026-11-28 (one row per decisions.md entry, Keep or Undo, an answer box)
tickets.description:
## What
A checklist with one row per entry in `docs/run/2026-11-28/decisions.md`: the decision, the reason and the undo line, then Keep or Undo and an answer box. The rows are filled by the integrator at the end of the run, when decisions.md is complete; until then the checklist holds one placeholder row. Each undo becomes a ticket or a change Claude makes.

## Why
The brief's finish: Phil reviews every decision made for him.

## Done looks like
Every row has Keep or Undo; each Undo has a ticket or a commit against it.

## Unlocks
- Any undo: its own follow-up

## Depends on
Nothing (the integrator fills the rows from decisions.md at the end of the run)

tickets.title: Keep or drop: items from old chats (one row per H10 undecided item, 47 rows)
tickets.description:
## What
Every item the harvest of chats outside projects found that matches no decision, one row each (47 rows in eight groups: ventures and makes, money, family, house and things, devices, personal, tools and scripts, July's one-liners), in five sittings. Each row has Keep or drop (keep / drop / later) and an answer box. The personal health row asks only whether to track anything; it holds no detail.

## Why
H10: nothing here has been put to Phil as a question; everything is undecided and not ticketed until he says keep or drop.

## Done looks like
Every row answered; each keep has become a ticket in the right project; each later is carried to the next review.

## Unlocks
- New tickets for each keep
- rescue.06: harvest items with no ticket land here

## Depends on
Nothing

## Red team
- Finding 64: DAY-3 (narration), PW-76 and PW-77 (scratch maps) and GARDN-4 (fan) already exist as tickets: their rows say 'already a ticket' rather than 'undecided'.

tickets.title: Live roadmap page: drawn from ticket links, next unblocked ticket highlighted
tickets.description:
## What
A page in Mycelium that draws every epic and its tickets from the ticket dependency rows (`ticket_dependencies`, both directions) and the relates links, and highlights, per epic and overall, the next ticket that nothing open blocks. Read-only, inside the app under the user's session (no public route). It replaces the one-off map in Docs (review.04) as the thing Phil looks at.

## Why
Final five 1: a live roadmap page in Mycelium (drawn from ticket links, next unblocked ticket highlighted) as a ticket.

## Done looks like
The page lists every epic from this run; closing a blocker makes the next ticket light up on reload; build, unit and end-to-end checks pass.

## Unlocks
- The weekly review: one page shows what is next

## Depends on
Nothing
